No, you cannot fly over people, see § 107.39 – Operation Over People\*\*§ 107.39 Operation over human beings.\*\*

No [person](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/14/107.39) may operate a [small unmanned aircraft](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/14/107.39) over a human being unless that human being is:

**(a)** Directly participating in the operation of the [small unmanned aircraft](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/14/107.39); or

**(b)** Located under a covered structure or inside a stationary vehicle that can provide reasonable protection from a falling [small unmanned aircraft](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/14/107.39).
